votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the request to designate the Miles Romney Home as a local landmark site.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Ordinance No. 2025-023 amending the Atkinville Interchange PD-C (Planned Development Commercial) zone on approximately 2.01 acres located southeast of Pioneer Road on the existing private road.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Tanner to approve Ordinance No. 2025-024 amending the Dinosaur Crossing PD-C (Planned Development Commercial) zone and approve the design and site plan on approximately 0.66 acres located at the northeast corner of Dinosaur Crossing Drive and Mall Drive.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Ordinance No. 2025-025 changing the zone from R-1-10 (Single-Family Residential 10,000 SF minimum lot size) to R-1-6 (Single-Family Residential 6,000 SF minimum lot size) on approximately 1.06 acres generally located at the northern end of the 950 West Circle cul-de-sac, north of 730 North Circle.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Tanner to approve Ordinance No. 2025-026 changing the zone from C-3 (General Commercial) to PD-C (Planned Development Commercial) on approximately 5.73 acres generally located on the north side of 850 North and west of 2957 East, with no conditions.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to adjourn.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
